banks.name: BASEL–ECOR
banks.description: Saved sequence-only model predictions paired with recorded BASEL phage–ECOR host assays.
banks.scoreMeaning: Raw saved model score for ranking; not a calibrated susceptibility probability.
banks.observationMeaning: Binary recorded individual phage–host assay; not a tested mixture or clinical outcome.
banks.clusterMeaning: Canonical k=21, 2,048-hash sequence clusters at Mash-form distance 0.05; not ANI or a validated cocktail diversity rule.
limitations: Saved AUROC is 0.470, below the chance reference of 0.5; this bank does not establish useful discrimination.
Severe miscalibration: saved expected calibration error is 0.744; the raw scores are not reliable probabilities.
All 25 hosts fall in one sequence cluster at distance 0.05; the primary cluster-bootstrap confidence interval is unavailable.
Every external host is within distance 0.05 of a training reference; this is not dual-axis sequence-cold validation.
The full 448-input model could not be evaluated because four VHIP columns were unavailable.
60 of 1,300 possible bank cells have neither an included saved score nor an assay observation and are omitted from rankings.
Recorded prediction locking on public data does not independently certify historical blinding.
Candidate mixtures have not been tested for interactions, resistance, safety, or treatment efficacy.

metrics.confidenceIntervalNote: Fewer than two sequence clusters on an entity axis

banks.name: Pseudomonas
banks.description: Saved nested held-out host predictions from a published 19-phage Pseudomonas bank.
banks.evaluationMode: Five outer held-out host folds; three inner folds tune neighbour count; identity grouping
banks.scoreMeaning: Raw saved neighbour score for ranking; calibration was not established.
banks.observationMeaning: Binary recorded individual phage–host assay; not a tested mixture or clinical outcome.
banks.clusterMeaning: Phage sequence diversity metadata unavailable for this bank.
limitations: The model was trained within this bank; it does not demonstrate transport of frozen weights to a new data source.
Identity grouping is a fixed demo setting; related-host grouped saved AUROC falls to 0.619 at 0.0001 and 0.509 at 0.001.
Only 23 hosts are represented; saved metrics condition on the existing fits and source panel.
No phage sequence cluster metadata is available; no phage diversity or compatibility constraint can be inferred.
Source phage and host accessions retain their published identifier forms; no fuzzy matches were introduced.
Candidate mixtures have not been tested for interactions, resistance, safety, or treatment efficacy.

metrics.confidenceIntervalNote: No pair-AUROC confidence interval supplied for this demonstration subset.
